_comment: Pinned by apps/web/scripts/docs-truth-check.ts and apps/web/scripts/link-liveness-check.ts. Counts here are compared against AGENT_TOOLS and every blueagent.dev URL is resolved against the real route tree, so a stale number or a dead endpoint fails CI. Do not hand-edit a count — change the catalog.

agent.name: Blue Agent
agent.description: Onchain AI agent for builders — idea, build, audit, ship, raise. 29 tools on Blue Hub reading Base 8453 and Robinhood Chain 4663, x402 pay-per-call in USDC on Base. Inference by Virtuals.

token.note: $BLUEAGENT is relaunching. This is the OLD token — do not treat it as the live reward asset. Terms: https://blueagent.dev/pledge

x402.note: 22 of the 29 are x402-paid: any x402-capable agent can call the endpoint and pay per call in USDC, no API key. The 7 in free_tools are priced $0.00 — they never answer 402 and never ask for a signature, so POST them directly and do not build an authorization. This file is a pointer, not a price list: /api/catalog is the only authoritative source for tool ids and prices. Install @blueagent/x402 to handle payment automatically.

skills.name: token_price
skills.description: Live price, market cap, FDV, liquidity and 24h volume for a Base token, from its deepest DEX pool.

skills.name: honeypot_check
skills.description: Decides whether a Base token can be sold after buying: honeypot patterns, buy and sell tax, blacklist.

skills.name: contract_trust
skills.description: Verified source, proxy risk, flags and community trust for a contract, in one verdict.

skills.name: base_stock_quote
skills.description: Coinbase Tokenized Stock quote on Base: DEX price, Chainlink oracle price, the drift between them, and buy impact.

skills.name: base_stock_movers
skills.description: 24h gainers and losers across every Coinbase Tokenized Stock on Base, by deepest-pool change.

skills.name: liquidity_depth
skills.description: What a $1k, $10k and $100k exit does to a Base token's price, and the largest position it can absorb.

skills.name: wallet_risk
skills.description: Sanctions, mixer and flag screening for a wallet before an agent pays it or trades against it.

skills.name: blue_registry
skills.description: Search this catalog by need — every id, its price and how to call it. Answers what exists before guessing an id.

sdk.description: x402 client SDK — call any Blue Hub tool with automatic payment handling

cli.description: Terminal UI over the Blue Hub catalog — browse by category and run a tool with x402 payment.
